name: Adobe Acrobat Studio
desc: One web workspace for PDF tools, AI assistants and design
desc_zh: 把 PDF 工具、AI 助手和设计能力放进一个网页工作台
solves: Reports, contracts and decks live in separate files; drop them into one space and ask questions across all of them.
solves_zh: 资料散在一个个文件里，翻起来慢；放进同一个空间，直接向 AI 助手提问，答案带上出处。
best_for: A fifty-page contract needs a summary before the meeting in an hour; upload it and ask for the risk clauses.
best_for_zh: 一小时后要开会，手上是五十页合同；传上去，让助手先把风险条款挑出来。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：C+D — Adobe Blog index (https://blog.adobe.com/query-index.json), then IT之家 cove）。 Outside the window but absent from the ledger. Launched globally in English as a standalone subscription that replaces the Acrobat Standard and Pro plans (Adobe's own post plus press coverage). PDF Spaces is a capability inside Acrobat Studio, not a separate product: the post of 2026-05-06 adds new sharing capabilities to PDF Spaces, which is a feature update rather than a new product. curl is blocked by Adobe's bot guard (403); the homepage was read through a page reader. 首次公开日期来源：https://blog.adobe.com/en/publish/2025/08/19/acrobat-studio-from-office-to-home-school-work-smarter-with-ai
